events.quote: Before one thing (a singular noun) we always put a or an: "a book", not "book".
Use an before a vowel sound (an apple, an egg) and a before a consonant sound
Right: "My brother is a doctor." Wrong: "My brother is doctor."

next_task.correct: I have an apple in my bag.

errors.W2: I have a apple in my bag.

events.quote: After he, she or it, the verb takes -s: "She likes tea", not "She like tea".
Add -es after sh, ch, s, x and o (watches, goes) and change consonant + y to -ies (studies).
Right: "She watches TV." Wrong: "She watchs TV."
